dataset: INS RGPH 2024 official published census sector hierarchy
scope: 2082 unique sector codes present identically in the three official workbook raw-data sheets; no claim these cover every currently legally existing sector or informal neighborhood.
extractionMethod: Read original downloaded XLSX bytes using bundled openpyxl in read_only/data_only mode. Identify columns by exact header. Convert code cells to strings, trim surrounding whitespace, retain source Arabic/French spelling and numeric suffixes. Deduplicate repeated demographic/milieu rows by sectorCode; assert all nine identity fields agree within each workbook and across all three. Preserve first 1-based source row per workbook. No community data used as authority.
limitations: No longitude, latitude or boundary geometry columns occur in the three inspected raw sheets.
These administrative sectors are not a complete catalog of informal neighborhoods.
Source numeric suffixes such as زانوش2 are retained literally and require separate presentation review.
